| 02 | [Streams, Redirection & Pipes](../../M04-Linux%20&%20Shell/02-Streams,%20Redirection%20&%20Pipes.ipynb) | 🟢 Beginner | ✅ | stdin/stdout/stderr, redirection, pipes, tee, xargs, exit codes and pipefail, here-documents, process substitution. |

| 05 | [JSON on the Command Line with jq](../../M04-Linux%20&%20Shell/05-JSON%20on%20the%20Command%20Line%20with%20jq.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | jq paths, select/map/group_by, analysing every course notebook as JSON, JSON Lines logs. |
